profile.about: I'm a detail-oriented Software Designer, passionate about micro interactions, animations, and the art of design. With a track record of bringing products to life and enhancing existing ones (over 5+ years), I blend creativity with my engineering background to deliver mindful user experiences.

items.heading: Product designer at InstaDeep
items.description:
* Collaborating on a design system to help accelerate new projects’ creation, and insure consistency across non-branded projects

* Creating fun animations and micro-interactions to make our products feel dynamic (which increased the wow! effect by 2 wows/user).

* Introduced tools like Rive, Lottie, and Framer, which helped us reduce developer frustration and reduce development time by up to one week on average.

* Redesigned a couple of products, improving the UX and modernizing the UI. Which for some projects, paired with great enhancement by the AI team, tripled the product usage over less than 1 year.

* Brought to life many innovative AI related projects.

items.heading: UI Designer at Weare Moon
items.description:
* Designed an award-winning platform (Sehaty Online).

* Designed a high-fidelity wireframe, and assisted during user testing sessions for [WFP's Last Mile Ecosystem](https://innovation.wfp.org/project/last-mile-ecosystem), a Nobel-awarded project.

* Designing and ensuring the good delivery Of our work from UX to UI, then to the dev team.

* Helped leading and integrating new designers to the team

items.heading: UX/UI teacher (Part-time) at Ecole Polytechnique Sousse
items.description:
* Created the course plan, exercises, and exams.

* Ensured the good flow of the lesson while keeping the students entertained.

* Organized workshops to help students practice the newly acquired information.

items.heading: UX instructor (Part-time) at GoMyCode
